title: Alumni Meet
description: Connecting the past with the present.
longDescription: The Alumni Meet is a special virtual gathering designed to reconnect former and current members of the club in a meaningful and engaging setting. The event celebrates shared experiences, achievements, and the journey of the community while fostering mentorship, networking, and knowledge exchange. By bringing together alumni and present members, the meet strengthens long-term connections and reinforces the club’s legacy, vision,collaborative spirit.

title: Camera Handling Workshop
description: Mastering the art of capturing moments.
longDescription: The Camera Handling Workshop is a practical session focused on building a strong foundation in camera operation and on-set techniques. Participants will learn framing, movement, focus control, and handling practices essential for effective visual storytelling. Designed for beginners and aspiring filmmakers, the workshop emphasizes hands-on learning and industry-relevant skills used in film and content production.

title: Cineshark
description: Dive into the depths of cinema.
longDescription: Cine Shark is a strategy-driven pitching event where participants reimagine an underperforming film as a potential blockbuster. Teams analyze creative and commercial aspects, pitch innovative improvements, and propose investment strategies to achieve profitability. The event combines cinema, business thinking, and presentation skills, offering a dynamic platform to showcase creativity, market awareness, and strategic decision-making.

title: Cineshot Memes
longDescription: Cineshot Memes is a creative online event that encourages participants to express their passion for cinema through visual storytelling and humor. By transforming iconic film moments into engaging meme content, the event blends creativity, cinematic knowledge, and digital expression. It provides a platform for participants to showcase originality while celebrating movies in a fun, structured, and engaging format.

title: Cineverse
longDescription: Cineverse is an interactive, cinema-themed event that challenges participants’ knowledge, observation skills, and creative thinking through engaging rounds where teams decode connections, interpret film plots in unconventional ways, and identify movies using visual cues, fostering collaboration, quick reasoning, and a deeper appreciation of storytelling while offering film enthusiasts a dynamic platform to compete, connect, and showcase their cinematic insight in an energetic, well-structured format

title: Colour Grading Workshop
longDescription: This workshop introduces participants to the fundamentals of professional colour grading using DaVinci Resolve. The session covers essential concepts, basic workflows, and practical techniques used in film and digital content production. Designed for beginners and aspiring creators, the workshop offers clear, hands-on insights that help enhance visual storytelling and improve post-production quality.

longDescription: From Campus to Camera is a hands-on workshop designed to introduce students to the fundamentals of short film making. The session covers the complete creative process—from idea development and scripting to camera basics, lighting, and execution. Aimed at aspiring filmmakers, the workshop provides practical insights into translating stories into visual narratives, empowering students to confidently begin their journey in cinema.

title: Meesaya Murukku
longDescription: Meesaya Murukku is an exclusive film screening event curated for first- and second-year students, offering an engaging cinematic experience within the campus community. The event aims to bring students together through storytelling, entertainment, and shared viewing, creating a relaxed yet organized environment for cultural engagement. Designed with attention to quality and audience experience, the screening promotes community bonding while celebrating contemporary cinema in a structured and professional setting.

title: Poster Reimagined
longDescription: Poster Reimagined is a creative design challenge that invites participants to reinterpret iconic movie posters through their own artistic vision. The event encourages originality, visual storytelling, and design thinking as participants transform familiar cinematic visuals into fresh, imaginative concepts. Conducted in an online format, the competition provides a platform to showcase creativity, technical skill, and innovation while celebrating the art of film poster design.

title: Retrograde
longDescription: Retrograde is an open mic event that celebrates the fusion of classic and contemporary performance styles. Centered around the theme of old versus new, the event invites participants to reinterpret timeless art forms through a modern lens. From nostalgic influences to fresh expressions, Retrograde offers a vibrant platform for performers to showcase creativity, talent, and individuality in an engaging and supportive cultural setting.

title: Video Editing Workshop
longDescription: The Video Editing Workshop is a hands-on learning session designed to introduce participants to essential video editing techniques and workflows. The workshop covers cutting, transitions, effects, and storytelling principles used to transform raw footage into polished cinematic content. Ideal for beginners and aspiring editors, the session focuses on practical skills, creative clarity, and industry-relevant practices.

title: Curtain Raiser
longDescription: Curtain Raiser marks the official opening event of the club, setting the stage for the activities and initiatives planned for the year. The event offers an engaging introduction to the club’s vision, creative direction, and upcoming events through a well-structured and interactive session. Designed to inform, inspire, and connect, Curtain Raiser brings together members, coordinators, and attendees to celebrate creativity, collaboration, and the spirit of cinema in a professional and welcoming environment.

title: Cineshark 2.0
longDescription: Cine Shark 2.0 is a competitive pitching event that challenges participants to transform an underperforming film into a profitable cinematic success. Teams analyze creative potential, develop strategic improvements, and present investment-driven pitches aimed at reaching breakeven and beyond. Blending cinema, business strategy, and presentation skills, the event offers a dynamic platform to showcase innovation, market insight, and competitive thinking.

title: Green Screen
description: Behind you, a movie unfolds on the big screen.In front of you, the judge starts a normal conversation…
longDescription:
This is a event where a blindfolded participant stands on stage while a muted movie clip plays on the screen behind them. Since the participant cannot see the clip, they must guess the movie using only the hints they receive. 

The judge talks casually with the participant and subtly drops clues related to the movie. The audience adds to the fun by reacting in real time—cheering when the participant is close to the correct answer and staying silent when they are not. 

The event is interactive, engaging, and highly entertaining, keeping both the participant and the audience involved throughout

title: Movie Surfing
description: where movies change, characters flip, and only your adaptability shines
longDescription: This is a movie-based Channel Surfing–style event where the participant must think and perform on the spot. The participant comes on stage, and the judge announces a movie name. The participant instantly enacts any character from that movie using expressions, gestures, dialogue, or signature actions.Just as the performance begins to settle, the judge suddenly switches to another movie. The participant must immediately drop the previous character and transform into a character from the new movie. This switching happens multiple times without warning.The event tests spontaneity, creativity, and adaptability. The faster and smoother the transition between movies, the stronger the performance and the bigger the entertainment.

title: Task Masters
description: movie quest where every clue counts and every second matters
longDescription: Taskmaster is a campus-wide, team-based movie challenge where participants race across multiple locations by solving clues and completing fun movie-themed tasks. Teams must work together to decode hints, move through assigned routes, and finish challenges to progress further in the game.At each location, teams complete a movie-based task to earn the next clue, along with a sticker as proof of completion. Once all tasks are finished, teams receive a final clue that leads them to the hidden Taskmaster. The first team to find the Taskmaster wins.*The event combines teamwork, problem-solving, movie knowledge, and time pressure, creating an exciting race across campus.
